calls.title: multi project permissions
calls.summary: The discussion centered around a flexible ownership model for resources, allowing for multiple owner projects with distinct permissions. The adopted owner and viewer project model controls access and allows shared resources across teams. A migration strategy is in place to ensure backward compatibility by supporting multiple owners initially. Complex permission logic was emphasized to prevent access conflicts, particularly with secret projects, which require special handling. Additionally, the team explored using teams for approval ownership to simplify processes, and identified distinct permissions for editing and approving changes. Custom hooks and their management were discussed, focusing on maintaining security and administrative control. Challenges in sharing metrics across projects were addressed, along with plans for an incremental rollout of features and visual aids for clarity.
calls.keywords: multi-project permissions, owner project, approval flows, custom hooks, global resources, secret projects
